purpose: Define foundation-first commissioning and acceptance contracts across conventional occupied/technical baselines, mission/control, smart systems and isolated R&D layers.
core_rule: A conventional/reference baseline must be accepted before a smart/adaptive/R&D overlay can be promoted.
rollback_rule: Every promoted layer has a tested safe/degraded/manual route back to the last accepted configuration.
claim_boundary: These are acceptance contracts only; no unbuilt or unscoped system is represented as commissioned or compliant.
project_values: Remain null/open until accepted BODs, installed systems and discipline-defined criteria exist.
